completeness.why: Forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and the preview now pass their raw amount to the existing getScheduledAmount, which decides null/number/range; the budget template keeps its own isbetween hand copy (only a comment added) to preserve its round-then-halve result instead of carrying that as an explicit rounding argument of the shared definition.

interface.why: Reusing the existing getScheduledAmount(amount, inverse) adds no speculative options, but the one real variation (the template's round-before-halving) is not expressed in the interface; it is kept as a separate inline copy with a comment.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining copy in schedule-template.ts createScheduleList is left as-is and openly commented, not reshaped.
